summary.text: Rob Brooks is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 59, based in Saukville, and has been elected to the Assembly since 2014.
He chairs the Committee on Housing and Real Estate and is vice-chair of the Committee on Health, Aging and Long-Term Care.

paragraphs.text: Brooks was born in Rockford, Illinois, on July 13, 1965, and is married with two children and three grandchildren.
He graduated from Orfordville Parkview High School in 1983 and attended the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse from 1983 to 1986.
The Legislature's page lists him as a real estate broker since 1990 and a small business owner.
It says he was elected to the Ozaukee County Board, serving from 2000 to 2014 and as chair from 2003 to 2013.
He has been elected to the Assembly since 2014 and held the Assistant Majority Leader position in 2017.
